name: Rhonas
description: Rhonas is the cobra-headed god of strength of Amonkhet, later remade as a God-Eternal.

bio.text: On Amonkhet he oversaw the Trial of Strength, in which initiates climbed thorny vines, lost their magic to a toxin and had to claim a basilisk's scale for the cure before he gave them the cartouche of strength.

citations.text: "God Trials", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Rhonas's Monument", section "The Trial of Strength". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: He taught his vizier Hapatra poison-making.

citations.text: "The Writing on the Wall" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Apr 2017.
"The Writing on the Wall" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Apr 2017.

bio.text: In the Hour of Glory he welcomed the Hours and went to the Gate expecting the God-Pharaoh, but three insect-headed gods awoke instead.

citations.text: "Hour of Glory" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jun 2017.
"Hour of Glory" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jun 2017.

bio.text: He fought the scorpion god, felling it with a poisoned staff, but it pierced his skull with its tail sting.

citations.text: "Hour of Glory" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jun 2017.
"Hour of Glory" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jun 2017.

bio.text: As the poison unbound Bolas's magic, he remembered the dragon's corruption, named Nicol Bolas and cursed the God-Pharaoh before he died.

citations.text: "Hour of Glory" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jun 2017.
"Hour of Glory" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Hapatra introduces herself at Rhonas's Monument and explains that preserved bodies are enchanted to serve the living while they train for the Trials.
timeline.quote: We preserve the bodies left behind, and since training for the Trials is our mortal duty, we enchant the vessels to act in service to humanity.

citation.text: "The Writing on the Wall" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: Rhonas tells initiates they will overcome the trial's dangers or feed them.
timeline.quote: You will overcome them, or you will feed them.

citation.text: Crocodile of the Crossing (Amonkhet, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Rhonas's Trial of Strength: initiates climb thorny vines, lose spellcasting to a toxin and must claim a basilisk's scale for the cure.
timeline.quote: Initiates had to climb thorny vines and ride down a raging waterfall.

citation.text: "God Trials", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rhonas appears to reveal that poison from the thorny vines runs through the initiates' veins, stripping their magic and clear thought.
timeline.quote: Rhonas appears to reveal that poison now runs through their veins

citation.text: "Rhonas's Monument", section "The Trial of Strength". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Initiates must claim a scale from the basilisk as a cure, then return to Rhonas, who bestows the cartouche of strength.
timeline.quote: The final test demands that the initiate claim a single scale from the basilisk

citation.text: "Rhonas's Monument", section "The Trial of Strength". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Samut, Djeru and Hapatra witness the deaths of Rhonas, Kefnet and Oketra.
timeline.quote: Together with Hapatra , they witnessed the death of Rhonas , Kefnet , and Oketra .

citation.text: "Samut", section "Convincing Djeru". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rhonas, convinced of the myth, welcomes the Hours and goes to the Gate to greet the God-Pharaoh.
timeline.quote: Rhonas rejoiced, emerging from his temple and his Trial.

citation.text: "Hour of Glory" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: All five gods gather at the bloody Luxa, but the God-Pharaoh does not arrive.
timeline.quote: The five stood before the crimson shores of the Luxa

citation.text: "Hour of Glory" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: The Luxa drains through the opened Gate as the demon's spell unravels old magics.
timeline.quote: all that remained of the mighty Luxa was a few rivulets of red

citation.text: "Hour of Glory" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Three sarcophagi along the Necropolis crack open and three insect-headed gods awaken.
timeline.quote: three enormous figures stepped forward from their slumber, awakened by the demon's spell.

citation.text: "Hour of Glory" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Rhonas challenges the scorpion god, which charges him in silence.
timeline.quote: Without warning, the scorpion god charged toward Rhonas

citation.text: "Hour of Glory" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Rhonas hurls the scorpion god across the gate with a spell of vigor but it rises unharmed.
timeline.quote: the immortal went flying across the expanse

citation.text: "Hour of Glory" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Rhonas imbues his staff with poison and fells the scorpion god, which drops to its knees.
timeline.quote: venom powerful enough to slay most living things

citation.text: "Hour of Glory" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: The scorpion god grapples Rhonas from behind and pierces his skull with its tail sting.
timeline.quote: the scorpion tail, arched over the god, piercing his own skull.

citation.text: "Hour of Glory" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: As the poison unbinds Bolas's magic, Rhonas remembers the true history of the dragon, the corrupted gods, and the original eight.
timeline.quote: The great lie of the God-Pharaoh.

citation.text: "Hour of Glory" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Rhonas names Nicol Bolas with his dying breath and recognizes the scorpion god as one of his corrupted brothers.
timeline.quote: This god was once one of the original eight

citation.text: "Hour of Glory" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Rhonas dies.
timeline.quote: as Rhonas stumbled and fell to the earth, body convulsing, then lay still.

citation.text: "Hour of Glory" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: With his last strength, Rhonas curses the God-Pharaoh and hurls his staff, which his final spell turns into a serpent that wrestles the scorpion god.
timeline.quote: his final spell transforming the weapon into a living monstrous serpent

citation.text: "Hour of Glory" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Iput returns in tears and announces that the scorpion god killed Rhonas and means to kill them all.
timeline.quote: The scorpion god killed him. It means to kill them all.

citation.text: "The Hour of Promise" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Rhonas fought until his last breath and his monument fell, releasing his menagerie on the city.
timeline.quote: The destruction of Rhonas's monument released his collection upon the city.

citation.text: Uncage the Menagerie (Hour of Devastation, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Scorpion God emerges from a sarcophagus and kills Rhonas with its tail.
timeline.quote: Yet the Scorpion God's tail struck with lethal force, and Rhonas fell in agony

citation.text: "Final Hours", section "The Hour of Glory". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Samut and Djeru, guided by the young vizier Haq, find Rhonas's body and Samut rallies the survivors.
timeline.quote: We will embody the strength Rhonas taught us

citation.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: A khenra warrior wields Rhonas's reforged staff to knock the scorpion god back toward Djeru's trap.
timeline.quote: A lone khenra stood, hoisting Rhonas's staff into the air

citation.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Angrath leads ground units against God-Eternal Rhonas while Gideon and Aurelia lead the air, and after Gideon kills Rhonas, Angrath leads a charge that forces Bolas's forces back.
timeline.quote: After Gideon killed Rhonas, Angrath was able to lead a successful charge against the remaining Eternals

citation.text: "Angrath", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gideon stabs Rhonas in the eye with the Blackblade, draining the God-Eternal to dust.
timeline.quote: Gideon stabbed him in the eye with the Blackblade

citation.text: "Blackblade", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gideon kills the God-Eternal Rhonas with the Blackblade.
timeline.quote: Gideon was able to kill the god, stabbing him in the eye with the Blackblade and draining his essence

citation.text: "Gatewatch", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gideon kills the God-Eternal Rhonas with the Blackblade.
timeline.quote: Gideon was able to kill the god, stabbing him in the eye with Blackblade and draining his essence.

citation.text: "Gideon Jura", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Huatli, Gideon, Aurelia and Angrath lead a force against God-Eternal Rhonas.
timeline.quote: led a massive force of planeswalkers and Boros, Izzet, and Simic troops into battle against the God-Eternal Rhonas

citation.text: "Huatli", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gideon kills Rhonas and Huatli joins Ajani's civilian evacuation.
timeline.quote: After Gideon killed Rhonas

citation.text: "Huatli", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The God-Eternals tear the animated tree apart; Rhonas rips off an arm and Nissa relinquishes control as it collapses.
timeline.quote: Rhonas tore out one of its arms

citation.text: "Vitu-Ghazi", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gideon kills the God-Eternal Rhonas with the Blackblade.
timeline.quote: Gideon kills Rhonas using the Blackblade , completely draining the god's essence.

citation.text: "War of the Spark (event)", section "Act 2". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rhonas dies and Hapatra takes leadership over the refugees of Naktamun.
timeline.quote: When Rhonas died, Hapatra gained new purpose

citation.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: The Scorpion God fights and kills Rhonas and locusts descend on Naktamun.
timeline.quote: The Scorpion God fights and kills Rhonas

citation.text: "Accounting of Hours", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Djeru, Samut and Hapatra witness the deaths of Rhonas, Kefnet and Oketra.
timeline.quote: Together with Hapatra , they witnessed the death of Rhonas , Kefnet , and Oketra .

citation.text: "Djeru", section "Joining forces". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Rhonas's fall and the city's destruction she becomes a leader among the survivors of Naktamun.
timeline.quote: she rose as a leader among the scattered survivors of Naktamun .

citation.text: "Hapatra", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Haq guided the group past the fallen god Rhonas, where they mourned and resolved to fight.
timeline.quote: leading them past the fallen god Rhonas

citation.text: "Haqikah", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Scorpion God confronts Rhonas near the Luxa River in the Hour of Glory and slays him with poison.
timeline.quote: Rhonas fought bravely but was ultimately slain in combat by the Scorpion God's deadly poison

citation.text: "Rhonas", section "Hour of Devastation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bolas remakes the zombified Rhonas as a God-Eternal.
timeline.quote: Rhonas was zombified and remade by Bolas as one of the terrifying God-Eternals .

citation.text: "Rhonas", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the War of the Spark, Rhonas helps tear apart the Vitu-Ghazi elemental.
timeline.quote: Rhonas took part in tearing apart the massive animated Vitu-Ghazi elemental

citation.text: "Rhonas", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gideon Jura destroys Rhonas with the Blackblade.
timeline.quote: he was finally destroyed by Gideon Jura , who struck him down with the Blackblade

citation.text: "Rhonas", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
